text:
marco: heads up 999999999999999999999
marco: hey team 999999999999999999
marco: repro'd a flaky stall when cancelling Retrofit suspend calls on Pixel 8 with company VPN. coroutine cancels but okhttp keeps socket and next request blocks ~20s. anyone run into this? :thinking_face:
sofia: hmm that rings a bell. emulator or only on-device?
marco: only on device so far. Pixel 8 (Android 14). emulator + Pixel 5 work fine.
james: what pattern are you using for cancellable requests? call.enqueue or suspend fun (Kotlin)?
marco: suspend fun created by Retrofit. We're doing: withContext(Dispatchers.IO) { service.fetch() } and then cancelling the parent job. after cancel we immediately trigger another fetch which then stalls.
sofia: can you paste okhttp config? timeouts, connection pool, protocols?
marco: default OkHttpClient from our SDK builder. connectTimeout 10s, readTimeout 0s (streaming), no explicit callTimeout. HTTP/2 enabled.
marco: small repro snippet:
```kotlin
val client = OkHttpClient.Builder().build()
val retrofit = Retrofit.Builder().client(client).build()
// suspend fun Api.fetch(): Response
val j = launch(Dispatchers.IO) { api.fetch() }
j.cancel()
// immediate followup request
api.fetch()
```
sofia: could be connection reuse where cancel doesn't fully close underlying socket. TCP FINs stuck behind VPN/NAT.
dev-bot: Incident bot: created issue #5143 "okhttp cancel reuse stall on Pixel+VPN"
james: quick experiment: call.cancel() on cancel hook or evictAll from connectionPool after cancel. also try setting callTimeout(30s).
marco: tried connectionPool.evictAll() after cancel - helps but not full fix. adding call.cancel() inside coroutine's invokeOnCancellation prevents stall.
liya: maybe HTTP/2 stream state + platform TLS leads to sockets in CLOSE_WAIT. Have you tried disabling keepAlive to confirm?
marco: yes, disabling keepAlive made repro disappear. confirms reuse is culprit, but disabling keepalive hurts perf.
sofia: capture okhttp EventListener, and tcpdump if possible. platforms often differ in how they handle half-closed sockets over VPN.
marco: attached logs show socket in CLOSE_WAIT for extended time.
james: pragmatic SDK-level mitigation: provide a suspend wrapper helper that attaches invokeOnCancellation to cancel the underlying Call (call.cancel()). Add this to our Kotlin extension library and document it.
liya: agree. also add note in onboarding docs about Pixel+VPN keepalive edge-case so users who hit it know the workaround.
marco: drafting PR with helper and integration test (device matrix Pixel7/8 + VPN). will link to issue.
sofia: thanks. mark triage-needed and add to next patch as opt-in behavior. consider defaulting after more testing. :thumbsup:
marco: PR (draft): https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/1307 - includes helper + docs note.
dev-bot: CI: presubmit started for pr/1307
james: once CI passes, ship as opt-in and include example in sampleapp. maybe add a flag in SDK builder to auto-cancel on coroutine cancellation.
marco: will add SDK flag and sampleapp snippet. also adding a small instrumentation test that cancels a suspend call and ensures no stall on followup.
sofia: nice. tagging security for the VPN/privileged network note.
liya: leaving :lock: reaction on doc snippet.
marco: will update issue when draft is ready for review. thanks all :raised_hands:
